title: Singapore Family Tour | City Lights & Safari Nights
highlights: This Singapore family holiday is designed to combine iconic attractions, wildlife parks, and entertainment experiences into a well-balanced and comfortable itinerary for all.
Stay in a luxury property at an unbelievable price, offering premium family comfort and a spacious stay in the heart of Singapore.
Experience the spectacular Night Safari, offering a unique nocturnal wildlife journey with tram rides and close encounters with animals in their natural habitats.
Discover Sentosa Island with cable car rides, a visit to Singapore Oceanarium, and the Wings of Time show, offering unforgettable entertainment for families.
Travel smoothly with pre-arranged transfers throughout the itinerary, ensuring easy movement between the airport, hotel, and attractions for a hassle-free family holiday.
overview:
About the Tour:
Experience the best of Singapore on a perfectly curated journey blending iconic landmarks, thrills, and wildlife. Begin with arrival and a relaxed evening at leisure. Explore highlights like Merlion Park and enjoy skyline views from Marina Bay Sands SkyPark before visiting Gardens by the Bay with Cloud Forest, Flower Dome and Jurassic World. Enjoy cinematic excitement at Universal Studios Singapore. Discover Sentosa via Singapore Cable Car, explore amazing sea life at Singapore Oceanarium, and witness Wings of Time. Explore Bird Paradise, River Wonders and Night Safari before departure with unforgettable memories.

know_before_you_go: The local currency is the Singapore Dollar (SGD), and both credit cards and digital payments are widely accepted.
English is commonly spoken, alongside Malay, Mandarin, and Tamil, which makes communication simple for visitors.
Public transport is highly efficient with the MRT and bus system, while Grab is a reliable option for taxis.
The weather remains hot and humid year-round, so pack light clothing, sunscreen, and an umbrella.
Smoking is not allowed in most public areas, and visitors must use designated zones.
Littering, jaywalking, spitting, and chewing gum in public are strictly prohibited and punishable by fines.
Drinking alcohol in public places is restricted between 10:30 PM and 7:00 AM.
Visitors should dress modestly when entering temples, mosques, or religious sites.
Always respect queues and follow local etiquette when using public transport or visiting attractions.
Attractions often have their own guidelines, such as no flash photography in gardens or aquariums, which should be followed to preserve the experience.
Some cultural and religious sites may not allow photography, so travelers should check for signage before taking pictures.

meal_plans.name: Bermuda Plan
meal_plans.description: The Bermuda meal plan offers three meals at select restaurants, including breakfast, lunch, and dinner along with drinks included. Ideal for a hassle-free, all-inclusive dining experience.

meal_plans.name: Dinner Plan
meal_plans.description: The Dinner Plan provides guests with two meals included in their stay: breakfast and dinner.

meal_plans.name: American Plan
meal_plans.description: It includes all three major meals, breakfast, lunch, and dinner for the length of your stay. Generally, the rates on this plan are higher but offer a good value for your money, and of course, added convenience.

meal_plans.name: Modified American Plan
meal_plans.description: Also known as Half Board or Half Pension meal plan. It is a modified version of the American Plan and includes a room stay with breakfast and a choice between lunch and dinner.

meal_plans.name: Continental Plan
meal_plans.description: It is where your room stay involves a daily breakfast at the hotel. The hotel can either affix its option of breakfast menu or provide in the dining area for a buffet breakfast. Also, whether the room service provides the breakfast or in a general dining area, depends from hotel to hotel.

meal_plans.name: European Plan
meal_plans.description: Only the stay is included in the rates and that you will have to pay extra for using the hotel’s dining facilities. This can be called the “Room Only” Plan.

days.title: Arrival in Singapore | Leisure Time
days.desc: Welcome to Singapore! Upon arrival, you will be transferred from the airport to your hotel for check-in. The rest of the day is free for you to unwind or explore at your own pace. You can discover unique experiences such as Scentopia Singapore, where you can craft your own personalized fragrance; explore the colorful & interactive exhibits at the Museum of Ice Cream Singapore or enjoy creative photo opportunities with mind-bending illusions at the Trick Eye Museum Singapore.

days.title: Singapore Sightseeing Tour | Visit to Marina Bay Sands Sky Park  & Gardens by the Bay
days.desc: Today, get driven to explore Singapore’s most iconic landmarks. Stroll through the colorful streets of Chinatown & visit the Merlion Park for views of Marina Bay. Admire the DNA-shaped Helix Bridge and enjoy glimpses of the towering Singapore Flyer. Continue to the Marina Bay Sands SkyPark for breathtaking 360° skyline panoramas. Later, explore Gardens by the Bay, visiting the misty Cloud Forest and vibrant Flower Dome, before experiencing the immersive Jurassic World: The Experience.

days.title: Day Trip to Universal Studios
days.desc: Set off to Universal Studios Singapore, Southeast Asia’s only Hollywood-themed park, for a thrilling day of entertainment. Once there, step into seven immersive zones, from the adventurous world of Ancient Egypt to the high-energy Sci-Fi City. Experience iconic rides like Battlestar Galactica and Transformers The Ride, enjoy spectacular live performances, and meet your favorite movie characters. The park offers blockbuster attractions, family-friendly experiences, and cinematic storytelling.

days.title: Sentosa Island Day Tour with Singapore Cable Car | Visit to Singapore Oceanarium | Wings of Time
days.desc: Today, get driven to Universal Studios Singapore. Once there, head to the cable car station for a scenic ride to Sentosa Island. Once there, visit Singapore Oceanarium, where immersive galleries showcase diverse marine ecosystems, from vibrant coral reefs to the mysterious deep ocean. In the evening, head to witness the spectacular Wings of Time, an outdoor show blending water, laser, fire & music. Later, head to Sentosa coach park & from there, get driven back to the hotel.

days.title: Visit to Bird Paradise & River Wonders | Night Safari Experience
days.desc: Today, get driven to Mandai Wildlife Reserve for immersive wildlife experiences. Begin at Bird Paradise Singapore, where lush walk-through aviaries and flight shows let you witness exotic bird species up close. Continue to River Wonders, Asia’s first river-themed wildlife park, showcasing iconic river ecosystems like the Amazon & Mekong. As night falls, experience the world-famous Night Safari Singapore, where a tram ride takes you through natural nocturnal environments to spot wildlife.
